_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): SSE streaming endpoint — server-sent events for chat/progress/notifications, with heartbeat + nginx buffering off. Frontend pairing documented in notes.
name: feature-sse
description: SSE streaming endpoint: server-sent events with heartbeat (chat/progress/notifications). Client via EventSource.
notes: After applying: 1) app.include_router(router), 2) replace the heartbeat TODO with your real event source (queue/generator), 3) frontend: const es = new EventSource('/api/stream'); es.onmessage = (e) => { const ev = JSON.parse(e.data); }; — EventSource cannot set Authorization headers, so protect the stream with a short-lived query token or cookie if needed. Pairs with comp-chat (streamingText prop).
